description_en: Triggers an Agent to execute an AI automation task on Mobile nodes
description_zh: 触发 Mobile 节点上 Agent 执行 AI 自动化任务
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic run-agent-task --instance-ids acp-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 --user-prompt '去应用宝下载钉钉' --max-steps 30 --timeout-seconds 3600 --biz-region-id cn-shanghai --task-config-id tsk-260625-49be0000 --schedule-id sch-260625-pbj20000 --targets InstanceId=acp-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 SessionId=ses-260702-21bh0000。 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunAgentTask

parameters.description_en: The list of Mobile node IDs. A maximum of 100 nodes are supported per request.
parameters.description_zh: Mobile节点ID列表。一次请求最多支持100个节点。
parameters.help_en: The list of Mobile node IDs. A maximum of 100 nodes are supported per request
parameters.help_zh: Mobile节点ID列表。一次请求最多支持100个节点
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.description_en: The user instruction in natural language. The Agent performs operations based on this instruction.
parameters.description_zh: 用户指令（自然语言），Agent 据此完成操作。
parameters.help_en: The user instruction in natural language. The Agent performs operations based on this instruction
parameters.help_zh: 用户指令（自然语言），Agent 据此完成操作
parameters.name: user_prompt

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of execution steps for the task. This prevents infinite loops. Valid values: 30 to 1000. Default value: 1000.
parameters.description_zh: Task最大执行步骤数，防止无限循环。范围 30~1000，默认1000。
parameters.help_en: The maximum number of execution steps for the task. This prevents infinite loops. Valid values: 30 to 1000. Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: Task最大执行步骤数，防止无限循环。范围 30~1000，默认1000
parameters.name: max_steps

parameters.description_en: The timeout period of the task, in seconds. Valid values: 300 to 3600. Default value: 3600.
parameters.help_en: The timeout period of the task, in seconds. Valid values: 300 to 3600. Default value: 3600
parameters.help_zh: 任务超时时间（秒）。范围 300~3600，默认3600
parameters.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the Mobile node.

parameters.description_en: The task configuration ID used to trigger a task with the specified configuration.
